text: The model has identified a pituitary region abnormality on the brain MRI. This is a classification of the imaging appearance only and does not constitute a medical diagnosis; it indicates that the visualised structure is consistent with a pituitary tumour, most commonly an adenoma that arises in the sellar region and may affect hormone secretion and the optic chiasm [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-pdq]. Because the algorithm evaluates morphology alone, it provides no information about hormonal activity or visual-pathway involvement, which are essential for management decisions [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls]. A clinician would normally discuss further assessment, including a clinical examination for endocrine symptoms, comprehensive pituitary hormone testing, formal visual-field testing, and a dedicated pituitary-protocol MRI, as well as referral to endocrinology, neurosurgery and ophthalmology specialists [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-diagnosis]. Prompt medical review is advised if the patient experiences sudden severe headache, rapid visual loss, double vision or signs of acute adrenal insufficiency [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ninds-brain-tumors].
